newsitem.title: USA: Hvide to buy UAE fleet for $61 million.
newsitem.headline: Hvide to buy UAE fleet for $61 million.

text.p: Hvide Marine Inc. said Wednesday it has agreed to buy the 37-vessel fleet of Gulf Marine & Maintenance Offshore Service Co. of Dubai, United Arab Emirates, for $61 million.
Gulf Marine is the largest independent operator of oilfield service craft in the Arabian Gulf, with operations that extend around the Indian subcontinent and to Brunei in Southeast Asia, Hvide said.
Hvide, based in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., said the vessels will generate revenues of about $30 million for the next 12 months.
Hvide's stock rose $1.75 to $20.50 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
